newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle bid $109/dressed, passed-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle bid $109/dressed, passed-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids were few at $108.00 to $109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and passed by owners asking $111.00, with a few at $112.00, market sources said.
There were no bids reported on a live basis, but bids could surface at $66.00 to $67.00, they said. Owners were pricing cattle generally at $69.00, with a few at $70.00.
Sales last week were mostly at $110.00, with a few at $111.00, the sources said.
Fed cattle this week were not expected to trade until Wednesday or Thursday, they said.
